name: codex-conductor
description: Persistent task orchestration for Codex projects with automatic project state, blocking decision gates, dependency-aware tasks, and at most one worker subagent at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent task and decision orchestration for Codex projects
interface.longDescription: Keeps project state, task dependencies, blocking user decisions, resume context, and a single-worker handoff policy synchronized while you use normal Codex prompts and skills.
